content: Pacing/progression pitfalls: grind becomes a problem when progression stops working (players forced to repeat mastered content); early game too slow is a common killer -- add temporary positive-sum early-game ramp; power creep from new content raising power ceiling -- use horizontal progression and seasonal resets; plateaus are useful but too long = frustration; momentum must be visible; choke points in progression are risky bottlenecks; reward curve must match enemy power curve; encounter pacing should have frequent small rewards plus meaningful milestones; multi-system progression is hard to balance and must be designed from day one.
